author: KEXP
description: Canadian post-punk band Home Front reaches new depths with their anthemic, synth-infused sophomore release 'Watch It Die.' Live on KEXP, the Edmonton-based group share a performance of the album's title track and more.
title: Home Front performs "Watch It Die" & more Live on KEXP
